20366-wonderwings-and-other-fairy-storie.title: Wonderwings and other Fairy Stories
20366-wonderwings-and-other-fairy-storie.creator: Edith Howes
20366-wonderwings-and-other-fairy-storie.description: A book by Edith Howes. touching the ground with the tip of her foot, stood poised a glorious fairy, taller than any other there. She was altogether beautiful; and her wings--as soon as Poppypink saw them she knew why the visitor had been called Wonderwings.

3744-the-trial-or-more-links-of-the-dais.creator: Charlotte M. Yonge
3744-the-trial-or-more-links-of-the-dais.description: A book by Charlotte M. Yonge. hat by heart,' continued Gertrude. '"My dear Father, This is only to say that she is the darlint, and for the pleasure of subscribing myself--Your loving SON,"--the son as big as all the rest put together.'

60112-ireton-a-poem.title: _Respectfully Inscribed_,
60112-ireton-a-poem.creator: Unknown
60112-ireton-a-poem.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. This was the true spirit of the eminent reformers of the age of Charles the first. They had undertaken the important work of settling the national character and institutions, at a period when men’s minds generally were bent on obtaining an improvement of their social condition--and an extensive toleration of religious opinions: and to accomplish the great benefits their sedate and comprehensive minds contemplated, they strove to induce among all classes, severe and independent habits of thinking and feeling in reference to politics and

arxiv-2202-00358.title: Photonic quantum simulations of coupled 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{PT} -symmetric Hamiltonians
arxiv-2202-00358.creator: Nicola Maraviglia, Patrick Yard, Ross Wakefield, Jacques Carolan, Chris Sparrow, Levon Chakhmakhchyan, Chris Harrold, Toshikazu Hashimoto, Nobuyuki Matsuda, Andrew K. Harter, Yogesh N. Joglekar, Anthony Laing
arxiv-2202-00358.description: Abstract Parity-time ( 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{PT} ) symmetric Hamiltonians are generally non-Hermitian and give rise to exotic behaviour in quantum systems at exceptional points, where eigenvectors coalesce. The recent realisation of 𝒫 ​ 𝒯 \mathcal{PT} -symmetric Hamiltonians in quantum systems has ignited efforts to simulate and investigate many-particle quantum systems across exceptional points.

arxiv-2203-08171.creator: Carl Lian
arxiv-2203-08171.description: Abstract . Let ( C , p 1 , … , p n ) (C,p_{1},\ldots,p_{n}) be a fixed general pointed curve and let ( X , x 1 , … , x n ) (X,x_{1},\ldots,x_{n}) be a smooth hypersurface of degree e e and dimension r r with n n general points.

arxiv-2209-02661.title: Hardware Software Co-design of Statistical and Deep Learning Frameworks for Wideband Sensing on Zynq System on Chip
arxiv-2209-02661.creator: Rohith Rajesh, Sumit J. Darak, Akshay Jain, Shivam Chandhok, Animesh Sharma
arxiv-2209-02661.description: Abstract With the introduction of spectrum sharing and heterogeneous services in next-generation networks, the base stations need to sense the wideband spectrum and identify the spectrum resources to meet the quality-of-service, bandwidth, and latency constraints. Sub-Nyquist sampling (SNS) enables digitization for sparse wideband spectrum without needing Nyquist speed analog-to-digital converters.

arxiv-2302-08852.title: A renewal approach to configurational entropy in one dimension
arxiv-2302-08852.creator: P L Krapivsky, J M Luck
arxiv-2302-08852.description: Abstract We introduce a novel approach, inspired from the theory of renewal processes, to determine the configurational entropy of ensembles of constrained configurations of particles on the one-dimensional lattice. The proposed method can deal with all local rules involving only the lengths of clusters of occupied and empty sites.

arxiv-2305-10784.title: Numerical solution of the incompressible Navier-Stokes equations for chemical mixers via quantum-inspired Tensor Train Finite Element Method
arxiv-2305-10784.creator: Egor Kornev, Sergey Dolgov, Karan Pinto, Markus Pflitsch, Michael Perelshtein, Artem Melnikov
arxiv-2305-10784.description: Abstract The solution of computational fluid dynamics problems is one of the most computationally hard tasks, especially in the case of complex geometries and turbulent flow regimes. We propose to use Tensor Train (TT) methods, which possess logarithmic complexity in problem size and have great similarities with quantum algorithms in the structure of data representation.

arxiv-2309-06219.title: Learning Human Action Representations from Temporal Context in Lifestyle Vlogs
arxiv-2309-06219.creator: Oana Ignat Santiago Castro Weiji Li Rada Mihalcea
arxiv-2309-06219.description: Abstract We address the task of human action representation and show how the approach to generating word representations based on co-occurrence can be adapted to generate human action representations by analyzing their co-occurrence in videos. To this end, we formalize the new task of human action co-occurrence identification in online videos, i.e.

arxiv-2404-15284.title: Global 4D Ionospheric STEC Prediction based on DeepONet for GNSS Rays Thanks: Manuscript received: Corresponding authors: Haiyang Fu (e-mail: haiyang_fu@fudan.edu.cn) Thanks: Dijia Cai, Zenghui Shi, Haiyang Fu, Hongyi Qian, Yun Sui, Yaqiu Jin are with the Key Laboratory for Information Science of El
arxiv-2404-15284.creator: Dijia Cai, Zenghui Shi, Haiyang Fu, Huan Liu, Hongyi Qian, Yun Sui, Feng Xu, Ya-Qiu Jin
arxiv-2404-15284.description: Abstract The ionosphere is a vitally dynamic charged particle region in the Earth’s upper atmosphere, playing a crucial role in applications such as radio communication and satellite navigation. The Slant Total Electron Contents (STEC) is an important parameter for characterizing wave propagation, representing the integrated electron density along the ray of radio signals passing through the ionosphere.

arxiv-2405-19911.title: Full weight spectrum one-orbit cyclic subspace codes
arxiv-2405-19911.creator: Chiara Castello, Olga Polverino, Ferdinando Zullo
arxiv-2405-19911.description: Abstract For a linear Hamming metric code of length n n over a finite field, the number of distinct weights of its codewords is at most n n . The codes achieving the equality in the above bound were called full weight spectrum codes.

arxiv-2512-07881.title: Revised comment on the paper titled “The Origin of Quantum Mechanical Statistics: Insights from Research on Human Language” (arXiv preprint arXiv:2407.14924, 2024)
arxiv-2512-07881.creator: Mikołaj Sienicki, Krzysztof Sienicki
arxiv-2512-07881.description: Abstract This short note comments on Aerts et al. 2024 , which proposes that ranked word frequencies in texts should be read through the lens of Bose–Einstein (BE) statistics and even used to illuminate the origin of quantum statistics in physics.

arxiv-2512-19547.title: Shock-induced magnetic reconnection driving Ellerman bomb emission and a spicule
arxiv-2512-19547.creator: Mats Ola Sand, Quentin Noraz, Guillaume Aulanier, Juan Martínez-Sykora Mats Carlsson, Luc Rouppe van der Voort
arxiv-2512-19547.description: Abstract Context. The formation mechanism for the dynamic type II spicules has remained elusive for many years. Their dynamical behaviour has long been linked to magnetic reconnection, yet no conclusive evidence has been provided. However, one recent observational study found signs of magnetic reconnection, as traced by Ellerman bombs (EBs), at the footpoints of many spicules.

arxiv-2604-12665.creator: Zikai Song, Junqing Yu, Yi-Ping Phoebe Chen, Wei Yang, Xinchao Wang

arxiv-2606-02345.creator: Louise Davy, Stephan Clémençon, Charlotte Laclau

britannica-1911-york-nebraska.title: York (Nebraska) (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-york-nebraska.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-york-nebraska.description: Article 'York (Nebraska)' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 28), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. The city is situated in a farming and stock raising region, and among its manufactures are foundry products, bricks and flour. York was settled in 1864, was laid out in 1869, was incorporated as a town in 1875 and was chartered as a city in 1877.

pmc-10629285.title: SDRAP for annotating scrambled or rearranged genomes
pmc-10629285.creator: Jasper Braun, Rafik Neme, Yi Feng, Laura F Landweber, Nataša Jonoska
pmc-10629285.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Genomes sometimes undergo large-scale rearrangements. Programmed genome rearrangements in ciliates offer an extreme example, making them a compelling model system to study DNA rearrangements. Currently, available methods for genome annotation are not adequate for highly scrambled genomes. We present a theoretical framework and software implementation for the systematic extraction and analysis of DNA rearrangement annotations from pairs of genome assemblies corresponding to precursor and product versions.

pmc-10748306.title: The Performance of Diagnostic Tests for Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome Coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2) in the South African Population: A Scoping Review
pmc-10748306.creator: Natasha Samsunder, Nikita Devnarain, Aida Sivro, Ayesha B. M. Kharsany
pmc-10748306.description: To determine the performance and reliability of diagnostic tests for the identification of SARS-CoV-2 infection in South Africa, we conducted a scoping review to identify published studies undertaken in the English language from March 2020 to August 2022 that evaluated the performance of antigen- and antibody-based diagnostic tests for SARS-CoV-2 in South Africa.

pmc-11282218.title: Association of urinary creatinine excretion and body mass index with diabetic retinopathy in patients with type 2 diabetes
pmc-11282218.creator: Jin Ook Chung, Seon-Young Park, Bitz-na Kim, Dong Hyeok Cho, Dong Jin Chung, Min Young Chung
pmc-11282218.description: This study aimed to determine whether urinary creatinine excretion rate (CER), a marker of muscle mass, is associated with diabetic retinopathy in individuals with type 2 diabetes and to ascertain whether this putative association depends on body mass index (BMI). This cross sectional study evaluated 2035 individuals with type 2 diabetes. Twenty-four-hour urine was collected.

pmc-11343742.title: Source-sink synergy is the key unlocking sweet potato starch yield potential
pmc-11343742.creator: Zhicheng Jiang, Zihao Wei, Jun Zhang, Chenxing Zheng, Hong Zhu, Hong Zhai, Shaozhen He, Shaopei Gao, Ning Zhao, Huan Zhang, Qingchang Liu
pmc-11343742.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Sweet potato starch is in high demand globally for food and industry. However, starch content is negatively correlated with fresh yield. It is urgent to uncover the genetic basis and molecular mechanisms underlying the starch yield of sweet potato. Here we systematically explore source-sink synergy-mediated sweet potato starch yield formation: the production, loading, and transport of photosynthates in leaves, as well as their unloading and allocation in storage roots, lead to starch content divergence between sweet potato varieties.

pmc-11424326.title: Effects of virtual reality on stroke rehabilitation: An umbrella review of systematic reviews
pmc-11424326.creator: Jie Hao, Gretchen Crum, Ka‐Chun Siu
pmc-11424326.description: Background and AimsVirtual reality is an emerging technology in rehabilitation. This umbrella review aimed to identify, critically appraise, and summarize current systematic reviews on the effects of virtual reality on stroke rehabilitation.MethodsFive biomedical databases, PubMed, Embase, CINAHL, PsycINFO, and Scopus were searched from inception to December 30th, 2023, for systematic reviews with or without meta‐analyses published in English.

pmc-11511295.title: A SAW Wireless Passive Sensing System for Rotating Metal Parts
pmc-11511295.creator: Yue Zhou, Jing Ding, Bingji Wang, Feng Gao, Shurong Dong, Hao Jin
pmc-11511295.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Passive wireless surface acoustic wave (SAW) sensors are very useful for on-site monitoring of the working status of machines in complex environments, such as high-temperature rotating objects. For rotating parts, it is difficult to realize real-time and continuous monitoring because of the unstable sensing signal caused by the continuous change of the relative position of the rotating part to the sensor and shielding of the signal.

pmc-11660391.title: 2D or Not 2D, That Is the Question? Weight-Bearing Radiography vs Weight-Bearing Computed Tomography in the Preoperative Evaluation of Charcot-Marie-Tooth Deformity
pmc-11660391.creator: Christian Blough, Jaehwang Song, Max P. Michalski, Glenn Pfeffer
pmc-11660391.description: Category:Midfoot/Forefoot; HindfootIntroduction/Purpose:This is the first study to compare weight-bearing radiographs to weight-bearing computed tomography (WBCT) in the preoperative evaluation of Charcot-Marie-Tooth patients. This comparison is important as WBCT is not widely available, and its current role in preoperative planning remains unclear.Methods:We performed a retrospective review of CMT patients with cavovarus deformity with weight-bearing radiographs (WBR) and WBCT.

pmc-11693919.title: The impact of N-acetylcysteine on hypoxia-induced testicular apoptosis in male rats: TUNEL and IHC findings
pmc-11693919.creator: Majid Shokoohi, Amir Afshin Khaki, Leila Roshangar, Mohammad Hossein Nasr Esfahani, Gilda Ghazi Soltani, Alireza Alihemmati
pmc-11693919.description: The present study aimed to evaluate the impact of N-acetylcysteine (NAC) on testicular hypoxia caused by varicocele, focusing specifically on the regulation of genes related to apoptosis and oxidative stress in the testes of mature Wistar rats.Thirty-two rats were divided into four groups: Control (Sham), hypoxia, testicular hypoxia treated with NAC (Hypoxia + NAC), and healthy animals treated with NAC.

pmc-12770372.title: A Museum artifact classification model based on cross-modal attention fusion and generative data augmentation
pmc-12770372.creator: Ying Lu, Jiaxin Li, Lin Li, Chongxin Yuan
pmc-12770372.description: Cultural heritage preservation has garnered global attention. Museum artifact classification, a core task, faces challenges related to insufficient multimodal information collaboration and a scarcity of high-quality annotated data. Traditional methods and single-modality deep learning models struggle to achieve both efficiency and accuracy.

pmc-12777720.title: Evaluating the effect of rutin on contrast-induced nephropathy in rats
pmc-12777720.creator: Faezeh Esparham, Fatemeh Rajabian, Mahboobeh Ghasemzadeh Rahbardar, Bibi Marjan Razavi, Abolfazl Khajavi Rad, Sakineh Amoueian, Hossein Hosseinzadeh
pmc-12777720.description: Objective:Contrast-induced nephropathy is a common cause of acute kidney injury, and oxidative stress plays an important role in its development. The flavonoid rutin is of interest for its potential antioxidant properties. This study aimed to assess the protective effects of rutin against contrast-induced renal toxicity in rats.

pmc-12967266.title: Highly Textured Zinc Deposition: A Pathway to Long‐Life Rechargeable Aqueous Batteries
pmc-12967266.creator: Ang Li, Xinyu Zhang, Maochun Wu
pmc-12967266.description: Rechargeable aqueous Zn batteries (RAZBs) offer compelling advantages for large‐scale energy storage, including intrinsic safety, low cost, and environmental sustainability. Yet, their widespread deployment is hindered by uncontrolled dendrite growth and parasitic side reactions associated with Zn electrodes. Manipulating directional Zn deposition has emerged as one of the most promising strategies to address these challenges.

pmc-12991465.title: Evaluation of the Role of Artificial Intelligence-Assisted Diagnosis of Early-Stage Oral Cancer: A Clinical Study
pmc-12991465.creator: Sanjay K. Sahoo, Meenal Jethlia, Jagjeewan Ram, Mudita Chaturvedi, Harveen Kaur, Pankaj Kukreja, M C Prashant, Rahul Tiwari
pmc-12991465.description: Background:Early detection of oral cancer significantly enhances treatment outcomes and survival rates. This research evaluates the role of artificial intelligence (AI)-assisted diagnosis in identifying early-stage oral cancer.Methods:A clinical research involving 100 patients with suspected oral lesions was conducted. Participants underwent conventional visual examination and AI-assisted diagnostic imaging. Diagnostic accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity were compared.

pmc-13313815.title: A novel Companilactobacillus isolate from the CV Super M duck (Anas platyrhynchos domesticus) with probiotic and antimicrobial properties
pmc-13313815.creator: Nguyen Phuong Thuy, Vuong Tuan Phong
pmc-13313815.description: Background:The global antimicrobial resistance (AMR) crisis in poultry production has intensified the search for sustainable alternatives, specifically host-adapted probiotics. The Vietnamese CV Super M duck (Anas platyrhynchos domesticus) is an economically vital breed; however, its gastrointestinal tract (GIT) remains an underexplored reservoir for specialized microbial communities that may offer superior protective benefits compared to terrestrial poultry strains.

pmc-13316302.title: Beyond surgical risk: Multidimensional predictors of postoperative arm morbidity after breast cancer treatment
pmc-13316302.creator: Ifat Klein, Danit R. Shahar, Michael Friger, Irena Rosenberg, Sergio Susmallian, Daphna Barsuk, Merav A. Ben-David

pmc-13598359.title: Anti‐Allergic Potentials of Actinodaphne angustifolia: Integrated In Vivo Evaluation and In Silico Analysis of Bioactive Compounds
pmc-13598359.creator: Rabindra Nath Acharyya, Md. Abid Muktadir Risha, Novi Dwi Widya Rini, Sarita Manandhar, Sabina Shahi, Biswa Nath Bhadra, Asish Kumar Das, Katsuhiko Ariga, Shrabanti Dev, Lok Kumar Shrestha
pmc-13598359.description: Actinodaphne angustifolia (Lauraceae), traditionally used for treating inflammatory and allergic disorders was investigated for its anti‐allergic potential using integrated in vivo and in silico approaches. Safety evaluation in accordance with OECD guidelines confirmed the non‐toxic nature of the ethanolic leaf extract.

pmc-13647149.creator: Alexander Muacevic, John R Adler, Rizwana Anjum, Sara Zafar, Mohammad Tariq Mahmood, Rizviya Rahman Mafizur Rahman, Anna Bartosinska-Dyc
